claim: The European Tech Champions event is on Wednesday 11 November, starting at 18:30, at the Unicorn Stage in Lisbon's Beato Innovation District.
The event is organised by Unicorn Factory Lisboa, the Embassy of Italy in Portugal and the Italian Trade Agency (ICE), as part of the programme around Web Summit.
The programme runs welcome and registration at 18:30, Panel 1 at 19:00, Panel 2 at 19:25, and networking at 20:00.
Claudio Miscia is Ambassador of Italy to Portugal and speaks on Panel 1, "The Role of Institutions in Fostering European Innovation".
ICE organises Italy's collective presence at Web Summit 2026, held from 9 to 12 November, with about 30 Italian startups and small and medium-sized companies in the Italian national pavilion.
Applications for the Italian national pavilion at Web Summit 2026 ran from 11 May to 8 June 2026.
Giovanni Alberto Falcione is co-founder and CTO of Exein, and Pedro Petiz is Director of Strategic Development at TEKEVER; both speak on Panel 2.
TEKEVER is one of the four Portuguese unicorns that the University of Lisbon counts as coming from its ecosystem.
Unicorn Factory Lisboa named the winners of its 2026 Entrepreneurship Awards on 27 October.
Gian Volpicelli, a technology journalist at Bloomberg, moderates Panel 2, "From Startup to Champion: How Europe's Unicorns Did It".
